### Conditional Promises
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-may-1-11603054.html
Passage: 1 Kings 11:38
Points:
- God gave Jeroboam an extraordinary promise of a lasting dynasty conditioned on obedience.
- Jeroboam let fear overtake faith, setting up idols and forfeiting God's blessing.
- Although God's love is unconditional, His blessings require obedient surrender to His commands.
- Believers are challenged daily to choose David's path of faithfulness over Jeroboam's compromise.
